injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Barzal racked up 72 points in 81 regular-season games last year, including 20 power-play points and four game-winning goals. At this point, the team hasn't offered any specific recovery timeline for the 29-year-old center. Whenever Barzal returns, it should be in a top-six role that includes time with the man advantage.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Eklund's timeline would seem to indicate that he will be out of action until the calendar flips to 2027, though it's possible he makes a late-December return if on the early side of his timeline. While the 24-year-old winger is already on injured reserve, he could be a candidate for long-term injured reserve if the Senators need the cap space to make a move.

injuries.name: Nikolas Matinpalo
injuries.note: Matinpalo suffered an upper-body injury in Monday's 4-1 win over New Jersey. He hasn't earned a point in six appearances this season, but he has posted four shots on net, eight blocked shots and four hits. Jorian Donovan will replace Matinpalo in Tuesday's lineup against the Blues.

injuries.name: Kurtis MacDermid
injuries.note: MacDermid doesn't have a timeline for his return. He contributed one assist, four shots on goal, 18 hits and 33 PIM in 19 appearances for Ottawa during the 2025-26 regular season.

injuries.name: Mathew Barzal
injuries.note: Knee: The New York Islanders said on Monday (Oct. 12) that Barzal has been skating on his own, but there is no timeline for his return, according to Andrew Gross of Newsday.

injuries.name: Alexander Romanov
injuries.note: ACL: The Islanders said on Wednesday's (Oct. 7) that Romanov will miss the next six-to-eight months and undergo surgery to repair a torn ACL in his right knee.

injuries.name: William Eklund
injuries.note: Ankle: The Ottawa Senators said on Thursday (Oct. 15) that Eklund is expected to miss the next 10-12 weeks.

injuries.name: Ridly Greig
injuries.note: Strain: Greig was held out of the third period of Tuesday's (Oct. 13) game versus the Blues due to a strain, per Julian McKenzie of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Kurtis MacDermid
injuries.note: Upper-body: The Ottawa Senators placed F Kurtis MacDermid on injured reserve.

injuries.name: Nikolas Matinpalo
injuries.note: Upper Body: The Senators reported Matinpalo is OUT with no timetable for a return as of Tuesday (Oct. 13).

injuries.name: Jake Sanderson
injuries.note: Lower-Body: Sanderson is OUT for Thursday's (Oct. 15) game against the Islanders.
